title: The Compactness Theorem for Enriched Logic
summary: The framework of enriched logic extends positive logic (also known as coherent logic) from sets to structures internal to a symmetric monoidal closed category $\mathcal{V}$. This framework was developed by Rosický and the second-named author. The main novelty of this logic is that the arities of the function and relation symbols are now objects in $\mathcal{V}$. We prove the compactness theorem for this enriched logic. That is, a set of $\mathcal{V}$-enriched sequents has a model (internal to $\mathcal{V}$) if every finite subset has a model.
